race.comment: I AM ADONIS (1) resumes. Finally lived up to expectations at his fourth race start when he demolished a small field by 3.5 lengths over 1300m at Wyong in a Super Maiden last April in fast time. Fitted with the one solid trial when second over 900m. Can stalk the speed and close strongly. FLIGHT OF POWER (9) proved too classy on resumption when he rounded them up with ease over 1000m in a Super Maiden at this track. Has the upside to go on with it now. PORTICO (6) blinkers go on second up after he caught the eye late with a tidy fourth over 1100m at Wyong. Scratchings help his cause and keep safe. THE BIV (7) rounded them up with ease first up over 1100m at Wyong in BM64 grade. Ran fast time on that occasion and form has been franked.
